summary: Jinxin Technology Holding Co, a Shanghai-based education services foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a current report on Form 8-K) disclosing that Mr. Jun Jiang resigned as director, CFO and COO effective September 21, 2026, citing personal reasons and no disagreements over operations, policies or practices. The remaining board appointed Ms. Fangfang Zhou, finance and administration director since April 2014, as CFO the same day; no new COO will be named. The filing is incorporated by reference into the company's Form F-3 shelf. Watch for any restatement, control gaps, or follow-on departures.
